dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agencies, program beneficiaries across Medicare and public health programs, and specific entities receiving disaster relief and shipbuilding funds.
dimensions.evidence: This bill provides continuing FY2025 appropriations for federal agencies through April 11, 2025. It also extends various expiring programs and authorities, including several public health programs.

dimensions.assessment: Prevents government shutdowns, maintains existing funding levels, and continues specific healthcare payment adjustments and disaster relief distributions.
dimensions.evidence: prevents a government shutdown that would otherwise occur if the FY2025 appropriations bills have not been enacted when the existing CR expires on March 14, 2025.

dimensions.assessment: Extends funding levels across the federal government and appropriates specific additional amounts, such as $750,000,000 for the FEMA Disaster Relief Fund.
dimensions.evidence: for `Federal Emergency Management Agency--Disaster Relief Fund', there is appropriated $750,000,000, for an additional amount for fiscal year 2025

dimensions.assessment: Extends broad statutes across multiple departments, including the Department of Defense, Department of Homeland Security, Department of Justice, and Department of Health and Human Services.
dimensions.evidence: authorities for the Department of Homeland Security and the Department of Justice to take actions to mitigate a credible threat from an unmanned aircraft system

dimensions.assessment: Short-term continuing appropriations and extensions lasting approximately one month, through April 11 or April 12, 2025.
dimensions.evidence: provides continuing FY2025 appropriations for federal agencies through April 11, 2025.

missing_information: Total net fiscal cost of all combined extensions beyond the explicitly stated line-item appropriations.
importance_detail.rationale: This bill provides temporary funding for federal operations and extends numerous expiring authorities across multiple federal agencies, public health programs, and Medicare payment adjustments through April 11, 2025.
